title: Name.
bodyText:
Limited Liability Partnerships

The name of a limited liability partnership shall contain "Registered Limited Liability Partnership" or "Limited Liability Partnership", or the abbreviation "R.L.L.P.", "L.L.P.", "RLLP", or "LLP".
bodyHtml:
Limited Liability Partnerships

 

     §425-151  Name.  The name of a limited liability partnership shall contain "Registered Limited Liability Partnership" or "Limited Liability Partnership", or the abbreviation "R.L.L.P.", "L.L.P.", "RLLP", or "LLP". [L 2000, c 218, pt of §1; am L 2001, c 241, §1]
